A '''seeker mine''' was a type of [[Space mine/Legends|space mine]] designed to hunt down and destroy [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. A model of seeker mine was the [[M-L4 seeker mine]] produced by [[Galactic Solutions Industries]] during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="GS">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Starfighter]]''</ref>
